title: Reliquary Map Engine
subtitle: Sample Keep (48 × 48) · engine test bench
intro: The party has split up round the keep: Lyra to the west, Pip to the east, Kerra far to the south on the path, her torch lit. The portcullis is down.
tips: Lighting on / off (header) switches the whole light system: off, everything counts as bright and sight is walls only, as before lighting existed.

Day or night: use the Sky selector. By day the grounds are bright and daylight comes into the keep through its windows, arrow slits, the portcullis and any open door, fading across each room; at night only lights and darkvision show anything.

Kerra carries a torch, Pip has darkvision (greyscale), Lyra has low-light vision (dim light is clear to her). Select one to see the board through their eyes alone; click empty floor or press Escape to see the whole explored map again.
Get in: the portcullis lets sight through but not feet. The postern door (west) is locked; the GM can open it. Walk the path, the pond's plank bridge (Balance) or the muddy shallows.
The great hall has pillars that block sight, braziers, and a collapsed corner open to the sky (rubble: difficult terrain). The ogre waits inside.

GM view: the map is shaded by light; click a lamp to light it or put it out (the gate torches start unlit); lamp marks are GM-only. Colour: firelight is warm and the cellar fungus green; the GM's Lighting card changes any lamp's or region's colour and intensity, and the header's Colour button switches coloured light off for the whole table. Torches, braziers and the hearth flicker; set any lamp's animation (torch, flicker, pulse, ghostly, chroma) in the Lighting card, switch it all off with Animation, and watch its cost in the bar under the map. Select any token to see its one, two and three Stride outlines (dashed light, medium and dark green). Select a foe the party cannot see to mark it hidden.

Walls to test: stained glass in the chapel (light passes, sight does not), arrow slits in the armoury and tower, a heavy curtain in the tower, a force barrier and fungus glow in the cellar, an illusory wall in the library, a pivoting-bookcase secret door.
Terrain: hearth embers (hazardous), fallen glass (uneven), the pond (Swim), the bluff (Climb), undergrowth. GM: click the cellar's dashed area to flood it.
Sizes: Tiny rats share squares in the cellar, the Large ogre cannot pass 5-ft doors, the Huge giant prowls outside.
